input.text:
Dear Mr Tanaka,

Thank you for the honour of meeting your colleagues in Osaka last month. We would be grateful for the opportunity to continue our partnership.

Perhaps it may be helpful to share our thinking. It seems that a phased approach could suit your organisation, beginning with one plant and extending to others once the results are clear.

We would be pleased to visit again at your convenience, if possible in the coming weeks, to introduce our engineering team personally.

Respectfully,
Kenji Mori
Director, Partnerships
